title: Discount tiers
prompt: Orders of 100 or more get 20% off, orders of 50 or more get 10% off, smaller orders get nothing off. Return the price to pay. price_to_pay(200) is 160.0.
hints: Test the biggest threshold first, or the 50 rule catches the 100 orders too.
`if total >= 100:` return total * 0.8, `elif total >= 50:` return total * 0.9, `else:` return total.

docs.name: if condition:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines below it only when the condition is true. elif and else add more branches.
Comparisons. Each gives true or false.
